motion.name: scene-depth
motion.purpose: Native scroll moves distant summit peaks and independent foreground trees/buildings. Connected snowbanks, the shared route, and reading surfaces stay fixed in document coordinates; route strokes never carry data-depth transforms.

motion.name: shared-gust
motion.purpose: One elapsed-time gust drives wind-snow canvases, pine bend, and chimney horizontal drift across summit, forest, town, garden, and contact. Exposed regions use directional strokes; sheltered regions below intensity 0.4 use small round flakes. Summit intensity 1, forest 0.7, town 0.32, garden 0.25; contact uses the town environment.

motion.name: pine-sway
motion.purpose: Skew inner foliage groups without overwriting SVG placement transforms.

motion.name: town-arrival
motion.purpose: Warm window and snow lightspills strengthen on town approach; static fallback is 1.

motion.name: chimney-drift
motion.purpose: Staggered wisps fade while drifting from translate(-2px, 6px) scale(0.75) to translate(var(--wind-drift), -34px) scale(1.25). Shared gust sets --wind-drift to 12 + gust * 25 px, coordinating with foliage --wind-bend.

motion.name: hearth-light
motion.purpose: Opacity gently varies between arrival-light and 0.93 times that value; gradient windows and snow spill supply static depth.

motion.name: garden-lamp
motion.purpose: Garden window-light groups reuse the hearth-light keyframes at a slower cadence.

motion.name: trail-sign-breeze
motion.purpose: Visible active forest sign link rotates between -1deg, 1.6deg, and -0.6deg. The native anchor targets projects, supports keyboard focus, and stops swaying with reduced motion.

motion.name: project-light-wash
motion.purpose: A warm radial wash appears over project screenshot frames on row hover and focus-within.

motion.name: motion-pause
motion.purpose: Top-of-page toggle clears weather and stops scenic/cloud animation while retaining scenery depth and traveler placement. The control updates aria-pressed and the on/off label.

motion.name: visibility-budget
motion.purpose: Only visible environment canvases draw; offscreen cloud, light, and smoke CSS animation pauses. A hidden document cancels requestAnimationFrame and pauses these CSS loops; small screens receive fewer particles and canvas pixel ratio is capped at 1.5.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Clear scenic transforms, place traveler at trail start without stride, hide weather canvases, disable smooth scrolling and cloud/smoke/CSS animation/transitions; disable scenery toggle and show Motion reduced.

motion.name: connected-ground
motion.value: fixed page-space route; remeasure on layout changes
motion.purpose: One journey-ground SVG shares a measured path across bank, edge, and core. measureTrail joins cubic bends with shared endpoints and aligned vertical tangent directions; resize, ResizeObserver, and font readiness trigger measurement. Scroll, pause, and reduced motion do not move this geometry.

motion.name: trail-traveler
motion.value: cached 513 route samples; targetY = scrollY + viewportHeight * 0.72
motion.purpose: Layout measurement samples the shared route; runtime binary search and interpolation position the decorative SVG hiker without per-frame SVG geometry reads. Stride is sin(scrollY * 0.045) * 1.6 px, so idle time produces no walking. Pause preserves position; reduced motion returns it to the start without stride.

motion.name: summit-clouds
motion.purpose: Three low-opacity geometric SVG clouds translate horizontally from -25px to 55px with staggered delays. Loops run only in a visible active scene with motion enabled; pause, hidden document, and reduced motion stop their animation.

narrative.overview:
A quiet winter descent frames a personal portfolio and blog: layered mountain silhouettes, snow-covered pines, timber houses, and warm windows suggest a small town inspired by Zakopane. The near-future premise stays understated; the implemented scenery is clean SVG illustration with sparse texture, rather than a dense technological spectacle.

Straightforward monospace typography and opaque paper reading surfaces keep the person, project evidence, and resume content easy to scan. The landscape supplies atmosphere around conventional navigation and content layouts. The rejected image-generated raster proposals are not design authority; the implemented SVG assets and CSS define this world.
keyCharacteristics: Clean illustrated winter silhouettes with subtle texture.
Dark evergreen text on pale snow and paper surfaces.
CaskaydiaCove Nerd Font throughout, with simple hierarchy.
Flat reading panels and conventional portfolio layouts.
Blog indexes, tag archives, and articles reuse the same paper surfaces and monospace hierarchy.
One continuous road and snow plane across transparent scenic sections.
Shared winter weather and scroll-driven scenery around stationary reading surfaces, with pause and reduced-motion support.

rules.name: The Paper Rule
rules.body: Put dense reading content and detail-page headings on opaque paper surfaces so illustration never compromises contrast.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Use the chosen CaskaydiaCove stack throughout; preserve plain portfolio typography instead of introducing a fancy display pairing.

rules.name: The Quiet Motion Rule
rules.body: Move scenery around stationary reading surfaces with native scrolling; provide a pause control, honor reduced motion, and suspend effects outside the visible scene.

rules.name: The Connected Ground Rule
rules.body: Keep the route and connected snowbanks outside parallax transforms; share road geometry across sections and move only independent scenery around it.

dos: Do use the actual SVG winter assets and subtle texture as the visual authority.
Do keep resume content and project evidence legible on opaque paper surfaces.
Do preserve CaskaydiaCove, straightforward navigation, and simple layouts.
Do retain visible keyboard focus and reduced-motion behavior.
Do keep real portraits and project screenshots alongside illustrated scenery.
Do preserve the shared route geometry and depth order across section boundaries.
Do use the established paper, type, divider, and focus treatments for blog posts and tag archives.
donts: Don't use the rejected image-generated raster proposals as assets or design authority.
Don't add fancy typography or elaborate layouts that compete with the portfolio.
Don't replace the quiet winter town with dense neon or gothic imagery.
Don't move reading surfaces with the scenery, hijack native scrolling, or run scenic effects while motion is paused or reduced.
Don't treat self-rating dots as independent interactive controls.
Don't split the road into local scene paths or apply parallax to connected ground.
